what: Charbert Solar 3, LLC has a pre-application for a 4.5 MW AC/5.625 MW DC solar energy facility at 299 Church Street, Wood River Junction, on land owned by F & E Enterprises, LLC. The board discusses it; no votes will be taken.
where: 299 Church Street, Wood River Junction, RI 02894 (Assessor’s Plat 11A, Lot 6)
next: No vote at this stage; a Major Land Development application would follow.
line: 4.5 MW solar farm proposed at 299 Church St: early review in Richmond, no vote
quote: for a proposed 4.5 MW AC/5.625 MW DC solar energy facility for property located at 299 Church Street, Wood River Junction, RI 02894 (Assessor’s Plat 11A, Lot 6). The Planning Board will discuss and consider the applicant’s Pre-Application submission, but no votes will be taken.

what: RI Church St Solar, LLC wants to change the approved plan for its solar energy facility at 391 Church Street, Wood River Junction. The board will discuss, consider, and possibly vote on the changes. The agenda does not say what would change.
where: 391 Church Street, Wood River Junction, RI 02894 (Assessor’s Plat 11A, Lot 5)
line: Changes to the approved solar farm at 391 Church St: Richmond board may vote
quote: for proposed changes to an approved solar energy facility plan for property located at 391 Church Street, Wood River Junction, RI 02894 (Assessor’s Plat 11A, Lot 5). The Planning Board will discuss, consider, and possibly vote on the applicant’s proposed changes to the previously approved plan.
